title: Cream cape fashion lookbook
text: A slow, soft-light lookbook reel that sells a full outfit: cape, tailoring and a structured handbag
idea: Fashion sells on mood. Warm cream tones, a gentle turn to camera and a slow push in let the clothes and the bag carry the frame.
why: One colour story from head to toe.
Movement is slow, so every detail of the outfit reads.
Made vertical for Reels and TikTok fashion feeds.
